name: Dell Technologies
description: Dell sells computer hardware and the services around it: servers, networking and storage to businesses and cloud builders (Infrastructure Solutions Group) and laptops, desktops, monitors and peripherals to companies and consumers (Client Solutions Group). Revenue is mostly one-time hardware sales with attached support and other services. The 2026 story is AI-optimized servers: revenue from them rose 166% to $24.7 billion in fiscal 2026, more than half of the servers and networking line, at an ISG segment margin of 11.7%. Dell is controlled by Michael Dell through high-vote Class A and B shares.

sub.name: Data-center networking, servers, optics and cooling

employees.note: Approximately 97,000 employees, down from the prior year through cost actions.

businessLines.name: Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)
businessLines.how: One-time sales of servers, networking and storage systems to enterprises and cloud and AI customers, with support and services attached; AI-optimized server deals are large, lumpy and lower margin.

businessLines.name: Client Solutions Group (CSG)
businessLines.how: One-time sales of notebooks, desktops, workstations, monitors and peripherals to businesses (mostly) and consumers, with warranty and service attach; volume and pricing follow PC refresh cycles.

businessLines.name: Corporate and other
businessLines.how: Residual revenue outside the two segments; fell from $3,581M in FY2025 and $5,624M in FY2024.
